summary: American Resources Corporation filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing a September 29, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement with Wyoming County Coal LLC to acquire West Virginia real property, structures, fixtures, and equipment, plus refuse-pile mineral rights, for a $40.0 million purchase price effected via settlement of UMB Bank v. Wyoming County Coal litigation. Assets transfer free of liens, with WCC indemnifying and mutual releases; no mining permits or historical liabilities assumed. ARC frames the deal as critical-mineral feedstock optionality. Watch permitting, refuse-recovery feasibility, and whether the settlement clears WCC's overhang without residual claims.
